Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Crypt's Sons explicitly says that they allow you to "cancel combat and
continue the action". Can you use their special ability on a Leave
Torpor action, which doesn't have a combat to cancel?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


While hoping the blocking vampire doesn't diablerize the acting vampire, sure.
(Same as with a Ghoul Escort).

If the blocking vampire diablerizes the acting vampire, the continuance wouldn't
get far.

Messages.Author: Malone
Messages.Body:


Just to be sure I understand...

"Cancel combat" and "continue the action" both happen but do not
depend on each other, so there being no combat to cancel doesn't stop
the action continuing (although the previously acting vampire going to
the ash heap does!) and, likewise, if continuing the action were
impossible (I can't think right now of how that would happen) the
combat could still be canceled.

Right?
